# v0.9.1 — Clearer charging activity

- Command results name the trigger, requested current, time and reason in HA and the app.
- Plug & Charge preserves a confirmed running current instead of restoring an old pause setpoint.
- Charging status now explains brief transitions, missing readings and persistent ambiguity.
- The app and integration exchange command origins, including deferred actions.

Update the app to **0.9.1** before updating the integration.
